description: Turn dark previews on or off for a git deployment, and set how long they live and how many may run at once. With previews on, every push to a branch OTHER than the watched one gets its own Tor hidden service — no DNS record, no certificate, no CT log entry — which disappears when the branch is deleted or the TTL runs out. Needs a deployment created from git with its push webhook connected. Previews run on the customer's own VPS, so the cap is what stops forty branches from exhausting the box.

enabled.description: On or off. Turning it off leaves running previews alone until they expire.

max.description: How many previews may run at once (1-20, default 5). Over the cap the oldest is retired.

ttl_hours.description: Hours a preview lives after the LAST push to its branch (1-168, default 24). Every push slides it forward.

name: impreza_configure_previews
title: Configure dark previews
